disclaimer: hand-reasoned order-of-magnitude estimates for a mid-size Indian merchant portfolio, not measured figures; the relative weighting is the claim, not the absolute values

spike_sentinel.false_positive_effect: a legitimate high-value transaction is declined
spike_sentinel.false_negative_effect: fraud settles, then arrives as a chargeback

assumptions.false_positive: ~10% of a declined basket's value is lost to abandonment and merchant trust damage; mean flagged basket in the held-out set is roughly Rs 8,500. A declined customer retries elsewhere ~40% of the time and a share never returns.
assumptions.false_negative: full transaction value written off plus a Rs 1,500-2,500 chargeback handling fee; card networks also penalise merchants whose chargeback ratio crosses ~0.9%, which this ignores.

ring_detector.false_positive_effect: a family, office, or shared-device household is locked out together

assumptions.false_positive: the whole cluster is actioned at once, so one wrong call multiplies across every member: ~3-6 accounts x support handling + lost lifetime value. This is the agent where a false positive is least recoverable, because the affected users are unrelated to each other and all get punished.
assumptions.false_negative: a ring is not one loss but a stream: a missed cluster keeps transacting until caught by another control. Sized as ~5 accounts x several transactions before independent detection.

content_forensics.policy: escalate to a human rather than auto-block — a wrong block costs too much relative to a miss
content_forensics.false_positive_effect: a genuine customer's dispute is wrongly denied
content_forensics.false_negative_effect: a fabricated dispute is paid out

assumptions.false_positive: regulatory and reputational exposure dominates the direct amount: a wrongly denied complaint can escalate to the banking ombudsman, and denying a real victim of fraud a second time is the single worst customer outcome in this system.
assumptions.false_negative: refund value plus handling; AI-generated dispute narratives are cheap to mass-produce, so the real risk is volume rather than any single payout.
